goal: Diagnose Windows startup barrier, author comprehensive end-to-end Windows UI test suite, and ensure software rendering resilience on Linux virtual display (TightVNC)
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Diagnose root cause of Windows launch failure and eliminate any startup crashes or background mutex blocks.
2. Fix variable scope ordering for $onLinux in VirtualDriveManager.ps1 and bind valid SynchronizationContext in NSCloudDrive.ps1.
3. Update launcher P/Invoke to FindWindowW with CharSet.Unicode and propagate in-process errors.
4. Create comprehensive end-to-end test suite tests/Test-FullWindowsUIEndToEnd.ps1 covering all views, buttons, themes, modals, and tray actions.
5. Resolve DRM dumb buffer failure on Linux TightVNC virtual display (:1) by prioritizing native desktop browsers and adding --disable-gpu flag.
6. Recompile NSCloudDrive.exe and regenerate release distribution packages.
7. Verify all automated tests pass with exit code 0.

decisions.decision: Initialize $onLinux at the start of Start-VirtualDriveMount.
decisions.rationale: Prevents terminating PropertyNotFoundException under strict mode when auto-mounting TeraBox accounts during startup restore.
Ensures the single-instance wait handle callback is properly marshaled to the WPF Dispatcher UI thread.

decisions.decision: Prioritize native desktop browsers (brave-browser, google-chrome) and add --disable-gpu flag in Linux launcher.
decisions.rationale: Eliminates DRM dumb buffer permission errors on virtual X11 displays (TightVNC) where GPU acceleration nodes are absent.

reviewFindings.notes: Verified all 26 UI end-to-end assertions, all 6 desktop regression phases, Unicode window caption lookup, and live standalone application window rendering on TightVNC.
